title: Clinical Management of Hereditary Hemochromatosis: Phlebotomy vs. Erythrocytoapheresis
brief_summary: The purpose of study is to determine the best and durable choice of treatment between phlebotomy and eritrocytoapheresis in the medium- and long-term clinical management of HH
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patiens newly diagnosed having Hereditary Hemochromatosis

Exclusion Criteria:

* Age \< 18 yrs.
* Not obese (BMI \<30)
* Not consuming alchol beverages,
* Not affected by systemic diseases and known hepatic viruses
